title: PARALLAX / DREAMSTATE V3 robustness layer staged
summary: PARALLAX V3 separates statistical significance from structural robustness using deterministic chronological evidence folds and local parameter-basin topology. Robust-ready sources must retain positive temporal folds once evaluable and cannot be isolated parameter spikes or sparsely sampled nonlocal points. DREAMSTATE consumes and continuously revalidates only robust-ready sources while preserving V2 FDR, provenance, bounded family search, source-decay retirement and shadow-only authority. This work is explicitly separate from the ICARUS Xi CHRONOFOLD subsystem.
evidence: three chronological evidence folds activate at nine evidence-complete pairs
deterministic timestamp plus decision-id fold ordering
local parameter basins require same non-axis parameter signature
axis-specific local distance prevents far parameter points from validating each other
temporally unstable neighbors cannot support a basin
isolated parameter spikes and sparse local coverage block robust-ready sources
DREAMSTATE live-source gate revalidation requires robust_candidate_eligible
V2 schema compatibility preserved with explicit robustness_version markers
